title: Managing Transactions and Staying Within Limits
summary: Explains what counts toward the monthly transaction limit ($175 free transactions per month) and that deposits, withdrawals, and transfers are counted; after $175, each additional transaction costs $0.25 until the next monthly cycle. Covers using an activity tracker (with filters), consolidating transactions, managing up to 50 scheduled recurring payments, and best-practice batching/alerts.
faqs: What activities count toward my $175 monthly transaction limit?
How much do I pay after I exceed the free $175 transactions—what is the $0.25 charge applied to?
How can I track how many transactions I’ve completed this month and how many remain?
What happens to transactions once I reach the limit, and when does the next cycle begin?
How many scheduled recurring payments can I maintain, and how do I manage duplicates or unused items?
What strategies can I use to stay within the limit (batching, consolidating, alerts)?
